scope: Original archive bytes identify the model. Body/joint structure is decoded by this fork’s NIF reader; this is structural evidence, not an independent original-executable death/controller oracle.
native_policy: Existing immutable NIF definitions and owned Down/scene/snapshot pipeline are reused. Reasonable collapse and persistence are required; bit-identical original physics is not claimed.

baseline.observation: Actor.isDead is true while raw Health retains0.597; legacy numbered death groups do not give this original Skeleton a death animation. Cold load leaves a bind pose.
baseline.note: The assembly ragdoll_bones log counts applied saved pose bones; zero alone is not proof of a missing physical rig.
